facts.value: Entry to Mechanical Engineering is through LM116 (Engineering).

metadata.chunk_title: Why Study Mechanical Engineering at UL?

facts.value: Students take a common first year programme but select which engineering discipline (Mechanical, Biomedical, Civil or Design and Manufacturing) they wish to study in subsequent years during semester 2 of first year.

metadata.chunk_title: Why Study Mechanical Engineering at UL?

facts.value: Year 2, 3, and 4 for the Bachelors programme, and Years 2, 3, 4 and 5 for the Masters programme focus on that discipline and offer students a number of specialist modules.

metadata.chunk_title: Why Study Mechanical Engineering at UL?
